subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw add non-USD semantics for configured model costs, and if so should currency live per model, per provider, globally, or only as a display preference?
rationale: The requested option adds a public config surface and changes cost/accounting semantics across status output, usage aggregation, persisted session fields, docs, UI, and USD-named telemetry; automation cannot safely choose that product contract.

options.title: Define contract first
options.body: Choose the currency scope and accounting/display semantics before implementation so local estimates, aggregates, docs, and telemetry stay consistent.

options.title: Keep local estimates USD-only
options.body: Leave configured `cost` as USD per million tokens and treat non-USD provider prices as unsupported until maintainers want a broader accounting model.

options.title: Add display-only preference
options.body: Allow a narrow symbol/ISO display preference while explicitly keeping stored values and telemetry USD-like estimates, accepting mixed-currency ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Define contract first
recommendation.body: Choose the currency scope and accounting/display semantics before implementation so local estimates, aggregates, docs, and telemetry stay consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent provider-usage and cost-history work by this handle touches the same product and UI/accounting boundary.
